name: Marching Cubes with QEF Vertex Optimization
definition: A surface extraction method that computes vertex positions using a Quadric Error Function (QEF) minimization for ambiguous cases, while using a 2D linear/binomial search for non-ambiguous cases, to produce a watertight mesh from a voxel grid.
summary: Marching Cubes with QEF Vertex Optimization generates watertight meshes by minimizing a Quadric Error Function for ambiguous cases, replacing linear interpolation with geometric optimization that respects local surface curvature.
